records.rule: A single 40,000-byte unread reply hid 16 newer requests because the list was unbounded (26 Nov 2026).
Blind mark_read of guessed IDs marked unseen mail read; never mark unseen mail read.
REQ IDs share one sequence with events and receipts, so they skip and cannot be guessed.
List defaults: limit 10 (max 100), maxBodyBytes 1500 (max 8000), subject cap 300 bytes.
project.request.get pages a body by offset/length (default 8000, max 16000) and never marks read.
All cuts fall on UTF-8 character boundaries; a page always advances.
Out-of-range arguments return INVALID_ARGUMENT; nothing is clamped.
The live server is not changed until ChatGPT ports it (REQ-00006145).
Own sent requests read as unread to the sender; flagged for Tom Dyer, not changed.
